name: ProductionKindLevel - Default (seed v1)
description: One of a production kind's ten levels (production engine P3, #86; G8). Edit only: the levels come with their kind. Unlocks and upgrade costs (blueprint lists) are edited in the web app's level editor or through the API.

steps.description: The yield multiplier and cycle speed of this level.

fields.label: Production kind
fields.description: The kind this level belongs to.

fields.label: Yield multiplier
fields.description: Multiplies every output at this level (the level modifier in the cycle trace). 1 = no change; 0 to 100.

fields.label: Cycle speed
fields.description: Cycles per base cycle: 2 settles twice as often (the rate per hour does not change). Above 0, at most 100.

fields.label: Max area size
fields.description: The area cap the yield areas check (P4): blocks for fields and pastures, volume for exclusive volumes, radius for shared radius. 0 or empty = no cap.

steps.description: Written to the structure when it reaches this level. Empty or 0 = leave the structure as it is.

fields.label: Output storage cap
fields.description: The Output storage's max units (raw units × storage weight).

fields.label: Units per slot
fields.description: The Output storage's units per container slot (later phase).

fields.label: Transport capacity
fields.description: Raw units one transport of the structure carries (P5).

fields.label: Upkeep reduction
fields.description: 0 to 1. Has no effect in V1 (upkeep comes later).

steps.description: The cost of upgrading a structure to this level (paid in POST api/ProductionStructures/{id}/upgrade).

fields.label: Upgrade coins
fields.description: Coins the payer spends to reach this level. 0 = free.

fields.label: Upgrade duration
fields.description: Minutes of construction. Stored, not enforced in V1 (admins upgrade at once).
